correctness.rationale: The first 2d+1 samples interpolate the full Laurent intensity A. The top B Fourier coefficient is −conj(α)(d−α)[A]_d, so after removing both known extreme harmonics the remaining degree≤d−1 real Laurent intensity B is interpolated by any 2d−1 distinct sample points. The exact identity (Re(zP′conj(P))−Reα A)²=AB−(A′/2+Imα A)² forces one global sign in the Laurent domain; plus forces Q=cP, minus forces z(Q/P#)′/(Q/P#)=2Reα. Rational-function order at zero is an integer k, and constant logarithmic derivative yields Q=c z^k P#. Support 0≤k−j≤d yields all nontrivial walls and excluded endpoint cases, and monomial pairs give every resonant failure. Independently computed d=2 reciprocal pair P=(1+i)+(2−2i)z+(3+0.2i)z²: the A and B profiles coincide at α=1+0.3i to floating rounding, but not at detuned α=1.2+0.3i. This finite check only corroborates the infinite proof.
